question: The compound interest (in ₹) on ₹72,800 after 3 years at the rate of 10% per annum, compounded annually is :
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

We can calculate CI by the tree method

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/776d34b2e1dd76efe8991fb1d5eb9736bf6cb10fdf4e90831194539c8e4f10db.png] 

CI = (3 × 7280) + (3 × 728) + 72.8 = 24096.80

∴ The required compound interest is ₹ 24096.80.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal amount (P) = ₹72,800

Number of years (T) = 3

Rate of interest (R) = 10%

**Formula used:**

Total amount (A) = P × (1 + (R/100))T

C.I = Total amount – Principal amount

**Calculation:**

A = 72800(1 + 10/100)³

⇒ A = 72800(1 + 1/10)3

⇒ A = 72800(11/10)3

⇒ A = 72800 × 1331/1000

⇒ A = 96896.8

C.I = 96896.8 – 72800 = 24096.80

**∴ The required compound interest is ₹ 24096.80.**
